mapper.select: select sum(dtl.Fsad_Current_Applied) as fsadCurAppliedCount from Fund_Scheme_Apply_Dtl dtl left join Fund_Scheme_Apply fsa on fsa.Fsa_Id=dtl.Fsa_Id where fsa.Fsa_State=7 and dtl.Con_Id=#{conId}

select case when bdAuditAmtCount is null then 0 else bdAuditAmtCount end as "bdAuditAmtCount", case when fsaCurAppliedCount is null then 0 else fsaCurAppliedCount end as "fsaCurAppliedCount" from ( select (select sum(Bd_Audit_Amt) from Inv_Budget_Declare where P_Id=#{pId} and Bd_State=7) as bdAuditAmtCount, (select sum(Fsa_Current_Applied) from Fund_Scheme_Apply where P_Id=#{pId} and Fsa_State=7) as fsaCurAppliedCount) a

select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, mn.* from Fund_Scheme_Apply_Dtl mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id where mn.Fsa_Id=#{fsaId}

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, dep.D_Name as fsaApplyDepName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Fund_Scheme_Apply mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_Department dep on dep.D_Id=mn.Fsa_Apply_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Fsa_Id where mn.Fsa_Id=#{fsaId}
